# Callouts / 提示块

> [!note] Note / 笔记
> Keep useful context close to the text.

> [!abstract] Abstract
> A brief summary of the idea.

> [!info] Information
> A fact to remember.

> [!todo] To do
> - [ ] Read the source
> - [x] Review the result

> [!tip] Tip / 提示
> A small improvement to the workflow.

> [!success] Success
> The operation completed.

> [!question] Question
> What evidence would change the conclusion?

> [!warning] Warning / 注意
> Check the assumptions before proceeding.

> [!failure] Failure
> The expected condition was not met.

> [!danger] Danger
> This action needs special care.

> [!bug] Bug
> A reproducible issue to investigate.

> [!example] Example
> Use **strong text**, `code` and [links](https://example.invalid).

> [!quote] Quotation
> A passage from another source.

> [!note]+ An expanded title that wraps gracefully on a narrow screen
> Body text stays in the reading color.
>
> > [!warning] Nested warning
> > A second level of context.

> [!bug]- A collapsed callout / 已折叠
> This body appears when opened.

> An ordinary quote keeps its own appearance.
